name: Exp_BykovTrend
summary: This EA trades based on the BykovTrend custom indicator, which generates Up/Dn arrow signals. It opens buy positions on Up signals and sell positions on Dn signals, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options. Signals are processed on new bars with a recalculation mechanism to ensure data integrity.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BykovTrend自定义指标进行交易，该指标产生上行/下行箭头信号。在Up信号时开多仓，在Dn信号时开空仓，具有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。信号在新K线时处理，并具有重算机制以确保数据完整性。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于BykovTrend指标的信号进行趋势跟踪交易。BykovTrend指标内部使用WPR（威廉百分比范围）指标，参数SSP控制WPR的周期，RISK参数控制信号的灵敏度。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时，产生买入开仓和卖出平仓信号；当缓冲区0（DnValue）出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时，产生卖出开仓和买入平仓信号。出场条件依赖止损和止盈参数，同时也支持反向信号平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数比例，并支持多种资金管理模式（自由保证金、余额、损失后保证金、损失后余额、固定手数）。策略还包含一个历史回溯机制：当同时开启开仓和平仓时，如果没有当前平仓信号，会向后搜索历史K线寻找是否存在反向信号以确认是否需要平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend-following based on signals from the BykovTrend indicator. The BykovTrend indicator internally uses the WPR (Williams Percent Range) indicator, where the SSP parameter controls the WPR period and the RISK parameter controls signal sensitivity. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value, a buy-open and sell-close signal is generated; when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value, a sell-open and buy-close signal is generated. Exit conditions rely on the configurable StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters, and also support closing on opposite signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the lot ratio, supporting multiple money management modes (free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss-balance, fixed lot). The strategy also includes a historical lookback mechanism: when both opening and closing are enabled, if no current close signal exists, it searches backward through historical bars to find a prior opposite signal to confirm whether a position should be closed.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/损失后保证金/损失后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（平空仓）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（平多仓）

parameters.name: RISK
parameters.description_en: ASCtrend risk parameter affecting signal sensitivity

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已收盘K线）

pros: 结构清晰，信号逻辑与交易逻辑分离，代码可读性较好
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高
使用SignalBar=1避免未收盘K线的信号闪烁问题
具有重算机制(Recount)确保指标数据获取失败时能重新计算
买卖开仓和平仓均可独立开关控制，适应不同交易需求
pros_en: Clean structure with separation between signal logic and trading logic, good code readability
Supports multiple money management modes offering high flexibility
Uses SignalBar=1 to avoid signal repainting on unclosed bars
Recount mechanism ensures retry on indicator data fetch failure
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled to suit different trading needs
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，点差成本未考虑，不适合小周期交易
历史回溯平仓机制遍历所有历史K线，可能影响性能且逻辑不够直观
缺乏点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
依赖外部BykovTrend自定义指标，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: Default SL=1000 and TP=2000 points are large, no spread filter makes it unsuitable for small timeframes
Historical lookback close mechanism iterates all historical bars, potentially impacting performance with non-intuitive logic
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
Depends on external BykovTrend custom indicator; EA fails if indicator file is missing
No position check logic, may open duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，提高交易质量
优化历史回溯平仓机制，限制搜索范围避免性能问题
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to improve trade quality
Optimize the historical lookback close mechanism by limiting search range to avoid performance issues

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查可能导致重复开仓，增加风险敞口
默认止损止盈值较大但比例合理(1:2)，不过缺乏动态调整机制
历史回溯平仓逻辑可能在特定条件下产生意外平仓
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may cause duplicate entries, increasing risk exposure
Default SL/TP values are large but with reasonable 1:2 ratio, though lacks dynamic adjustment
Historical lookback close logic may produce unexpected closures under certain conditions
